title: Research: Gaussian E8 all-clique certificate ceiling is 40 (no new kappa)
head: 54cbbea75b587bdf43a1c123e52220f936641d6f
body:
**Research note / scoped negative result. No new kappa.** Nonnegative weighted-clique certificates on the fixed 60-line Gaussian E8 configuration cannot certify more than **40 Gaussian pairing-rank units**, even when every nonempty nonorthogonal clique is allowed.

PR770 proves ceiling 40 for inclusion-maximal cliques and expressly leaves non-maximal cliques outside its theorem. This package closes that certificate-domain gap. It preserves PR738's existing scalar decoder interval **[40,60]**; a cost-40 decoder remains unconstructed.

## New evidence

- The initial attempt to extend PR770's 900-pair dual fails on a singleton: 42 hits rather than the required 45. This is a failed extension hypothesis, not a defect in the predecessor's scoped theorem.
- An exact repaired dual retains the **180 ordered orthogonal-normal hyperplane pairs with six-line intersection**, each of Gaussian pairing rank two. Every nonempty clique Q meets both hyperplanes in at least `9 |Q|` of these pairs. Summing their local constraints gives `9 sum_Q |Q| w_Q <= 360`, hence ceiling 40 for arbitrary nonnegative clique weights.
- Complete enumeration covers **2,068,372 cliques**, without a size cutoff. A separately implemented Gaussian geometry/rank checker and Bron–Kerbosch/submask traversal agree on all counts, size minima, pairs and the complete clique-set digest.

The matching feasible value-40 certificate is inherited from pinned PR738/PR770 sources. Their unchanged full primal flat-pair coverage is **not rerun or claimed as new evidence** here. This result closes the specified proof method, not all possible decoder mechanisms.

## Reproduce and validation

Python 3.10+; standard library only; offline and read-only by default:

```sh
python -B research/gaussian-all-clique-dual/verify.py
python -B research/gaussian-all-clique-dual/independent.py
python -B research/gaussian-all-clique-dual/test_package.py
```

Expected primary marker:

```text
PASS_GAUSSIAN_ALL_CLIQUE_DUAL cliques=2068372 ordered_pairs=180 ceiling=40 controls=6 no_new_kappa
```

Windows / CPython 3.10.9: both ordinary replays pass. A cold export of canonical staged Git blobs passes isolated optimized primary and independent replays (17.702s / 7.840s), produces an identical certificate and passes all **10 tests** (9.254s). The enumerators also match brute force on all **1,099 labelled graphs of orders 1–5**. Controls reject changed sources, certificate claims, invalid geometry, a dropped dual pair, overly strong inequalities and overwriting an existing receipt. Exact frozen evidence and input hashes are retained in `VALIDATION.md` and `evidence/`.

Selected-record integrity and staged whitespace checks pass. No full repository suite, selected supplier cold replay, Linux CI or formal multiplication-theorem verification is claimed for this isolated package.
